mapper.select: SELECT e.id,e.aggregate_id,e.event_type,t.status AS order_status,t.advice_id,t.user_id AS customer_id, a.status AS advice_status,a.customer_user_id AS advice_customer_id FROM event_outbox e LEFT JOIN trade_order t ON t.id=e.aggregate_id AND t.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN rebalance_advice a ON a.id=t.advice_id AND a.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE e.aggregate_type='trade_order' AND e.event_type IN ('trade.confirmed','trade.failed') AND e.dispatch_status IN (1,3) AND e.next_retry_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY e.id LIMIT 50 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE event_outbox SET dispatch_status=2,dispatched_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id IN #{id}
